g.text: Predicted scissors: correct and incorrect trials
Whitening; first complete 10-fold evaluation: 31 scissors predictions, 29 matched the cue label, 2 did not.
High-gamma: fixed ECoG channels 26, 37, 27, 16, 47; 50–300 Hz, 50 ms moving power, relative to -1–0 s pre-cue.
Shading: cue. References: medians of correctly classified trials. Cue labels describe the instruction; glove signals show execution.
